7.3.3 ECU Shutdown
To shut down the network, ComM calls the Nm_NetworkRelease API of the NM In-
terface, which in turn calls J1939Nm_NetworkRelease. The J1939 Network
Management module will then switch to ‘SleepMode’, and notify this to the NM In-
terface.
[SWS_J1939Nm_00015]
Upstream requirements: SRS_J1939_00036
